name: Lieut. Varnum
role: 7th Cavalry lieutenant surveying Black Hills routes
bio: Lieut. Varnum of the 7th Cavalry surveyed official routes to Fort Meade in summer 1884, finishing the Dickinson route, working on the Belfield route, and passing through with a squad of men on the Medora road; the Cow Boy's party overtook his outfit on its own trip to the Hills. In December 1886 the paper reported that Miss Mollie Moore had recently married Lt. Varnum.
